open_points.subject: pre-export room-name correction
open_points.text: corrects there every room name of the projects to be picked that breaks this rule
open_points.question: How can the owner correct a room name when R0-10 requires that a room is never renamed or removed; is this a one-time exception for the v1 source, or must the migration use another remedy?
options: Permit a one-time rename on the v1 source before export while preserving the room id
Transform the name only in the export, without changing the source
Do not import a project containing a noncompliant room name
open_points.default_guess: Permit a one-time pre-export rename on the v1 source while preserving the room id.

witness.initial: A picked VPS project has a room named "bathroom for the wheelchair".
events: The owner identifies that the name breaks R0-96.
The owner prepares the project for export.
outcomes: R0-96 requires the owner to rename the room before export.
R0-10 requires the room name to remain unchanged.
witness.observer: The owner and every consumer reading the room after migration

open_points.subject: pre-export correction action
open_points.question: What concrete action lets the owner read and change a room name on the VPS, what observable result confirms it, and what happens if the correction cannot be applied?
options: A supported v1 Registry owner operation
A dedicated mode of the one-time migration script
A direct source-store edit with defined validation and rollback
No correction action; exclude the affected project
open_points.default_guess: Add a dedicated pre-export mode to the one-time migration script that preserves the room id, reports every change, and fails the export if any requested correction fails.

witness.initial: A VPS room has a prohibited name and no named room-rename operation exists.
events: The owner attempts the required correction.
One implementer edits the source store directly; another rewrites only the exported value.
outcomes: The live v1 room is renamed before export.
The live v1 room remains unchanged and only the export contains the replacement.
witness.observer: The owner inspecting the VPS and the migration output

open_points.subject: binding checked projects to the import selection
open_points.question: How is the set of projects whose room names the owner checked bound to the subset later picked at import, given that R0-79 allows any subset and the import records or validates no such check?
options: The export contains only projects already checked and eligible for import
The export carries a signed or recorded checked-project list that constrains the import picker
The owner may pick any exported project and compliance relies only on procedure
open_points.default_guess: Make the export contain only the projects whose room names the owner has checked.

witness.initial: The VPS export can contain projects P1 and P2; the owner checked only P1 because P1 was initially intended for import.
events: At import time the owner selects P2 instead.
outcomes: The import accepts P2 because it accepts any picked subset and refuses no name.
The import refuses or hides P2 because it was not in the checked set.
witness.observer: The owner during import and the agent after P2 is imported

open_points.subject: consistency between room-name checking and export
open_points.text: The import then copies names the owner has already checked
open_points.question: What prevents a room from being added or otherwise changed after the owner's check but before the export snapshot is made, and how is failure of that condition detected?
options: Put the source into a read-only migration mode before checking
Check the finished export rather than the live source
Record a source revision at checking and refuse export if it changed
Accept the race and rely on the owner to coordinate writers
open_points.default_guess: Freeze source writes, check the exact snapshot to be exported, and abort if the source changes before export completion.

witness.initial: The owner has checked every current room of a picked active project.
events: A service adds a new room with a prohibited name.
The owner runs the export script.
Production imports the export, which refuses no room name.
outcomes: With a freeze or revision check, export is blocked until the new room is reviewed.
Without one, the unchecked room is imported and reaches the agent.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent receiving the room name

open_points.subject: meaning of imported v1 room names
open_points.text: the names the v1 instance gave them (A16)
open_points.question: What exact source value is copied as a room's name when A16 is not supplied here: the stored value verbatim, a derived display value, or a normalized/defaulted value, and what happens when that value is absent or invalid?
options: Copy the stored v1 room-name field verbatim and refuse a missing field
Apply a specified normalization while exporting
Derive or default a name for legacy rooms without one
open_points.default_guess: Copy the stored v1 room-name field verbatim and fail the export if a room has no valid name.
